details:
In Spookality 2026 there's a new UI element to explain the hype train(as picture 1), but this isn't the case for the new events like MetaFes or the rest(like picture 2).

It's mostly not good since not everyone will go to the SNS/sites or the in-game group blindly(plus when the hub/entrance world cost few hundreds of MBs). And back to the Spookality 2026. I heard of countless time of 'What is this world about?'(or why is everyone AFK I guess lol) for the new joiner, besides to the Hype train, there's no explains to the event, no schedule listed, no count down, no drop info, and no links to the event itself, some people will be so confuse, and think the world description might explain something, but it's the Spookality 2026 Hub World(like picture 3), and yes they will guess it's Halloween if they know what it is, but I personally found it's hard to expect people knows something(plus VRChat is international enough to make it happen more), anyway, I suggests:

1. Use the hype train UI element for the event info(include link and drops, schedule, countdown for key events, and which world or group it will use, or so) in the event tab

2. More info in the world description since some people never check world list, they only wonder what friends were in, also add world tags for easier understanding

3. Remember to translate it, since I found it's very hard to explain the event to non-English people

4. Don't rely too much on the sites(*). Try to explain or let people interactive things happened in-game, in the game. (*Spookality 2026 use domain most people have no idea what it is, the internet is quite dangerous nowaday, many just won't bother it at all)

And for the addition, the VRChat Home(picture 4) should not just have banners, it should also explain what the banner is about, yes it's spooky I might want to join, but for the same reason as above, it's hard to expect spooky is the only reason, otherwise not just old players will be confuse(if they use laser and check the world description, they will found the world hub is the world hub, plus the world name even not displayed fully, well, maybe it is the issue? https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/event-calendar-display-issue-when-the-event-name-is-in-japanese ) Anyway, the newly players will clearly be even more confuse since there's zero info on the Home and the world tabs, which is not a good thing
title: [1948] More event info in World UI tab and VRChat Home
